tool_args.rationale: Fit the guided three-parameter square-root siphon numerically across the full fallback range, using all seven rows. The added gradients resolve the pilot's vmax–rho collinearity.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired probe supplies wide sink-gradient leverage, and all observed gradients remain below the stated supercritical threshold.
The observed monotone concave response and subtree guidance favor the square-root siphon branch; fresh confirmation will test it.
